seo.description: Modern mullet and burst fade mullet haircuts in Carlsbad, NM: faded sides, real length in back, color optional. See real cuts and book on Booksy.

photo_alt.color-platinum-mullet-fade: Platinum modern mullet with the sides faded high to skin, long wavy length on top and in back, and a full dark beard
photo_alt.cut-curly-top-taper-neckline: Burst fade mullet from behind, dark curls on top and length left falling to the nape over a fade around the ear

paragraphs: Around 450,000 searches a month across the US go to one phrase: modern mullet. This is not the 1980s version.

Today's mullet keeps the front and top textured, takes the sides down tight with a fade, and leaves real length in back. That contrast between short sides and a long tail is what makes it look current instead of like a costume.

blocks.heading: Platinum and curls.
paragraphs: The first photo is worn platinum, with wavy length through the top and back and the sides faded high to skin. A full beard balances all that length.
The second is dark and curly. The fade arcs past the ear and the curls are left to fall to the nape, which makes it a burst fade mullet.

blocks.heading: The version people search for now.
paragraphs: A burst fade mullet combines a curved fade around the ear with the mullet's length in back. The burst keeps weight at the nape, so the tail looks like it belongs to the cut instead of being left over.

blocks.heading: Texture helps.
paragraphs: Wavy and curly hair carry a mullet easily because the back holds its shape. Straight hair works once it has enough length to move past the collar. Starting from short hair, expect a few visits where the sides stay tight while the back catches up.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: Faded sides, a shaped back and a textured top, with straight razor work along the neck before it is styled.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: The mullet, plus a trim or line-up for the beard and a hot towel to close.

items.title: Color Transformation
items.body: Platinum like the first photo is bleach and tone work, booked as its own service. Text me before you book a cut and color together.

blocks.heading: Sides short, back long.
paragraphs: Those faded sides need a refresh every few weeks to keep the contrast. The back only needs shaping now and then while it grows. Leave the tail alone too long and it starts to look shaggy instead of deliberate.

items.a: Short, faded sides with a textured top and noticeable length at the back. The fade is what separates them from the older, blunter mullet.

items.q: Are mullets still in style in 2026?
items.a: Search interest says yes. Modern mullet still draws about 450,000 US searches a month, and the burst fade mullet adds around 60,500 more.
A shorter back with a low fade reads much more conservative than a long tail with skin faded high up the sides. You can dial it up or down.

items.q: Can I get the platinum color too?
items.a: Yes. Bleach and tone is the Color Transformation on Booksy, and it is a long appointment, so plan the day around it.
